brief: Prioritise Sandbourne Bend (SUB-SGW-493) for pre-event attention ahead of the heat event, as its advanced age of 45 years combined with a history of high loading leaves it with a reduced margin against mechanical failure (MG-023). Because this asset has an ONAN cooling type and the supplied documents do not cover specific actions for ONAN units beyond general de-rating and maintenance prioritization, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 if pre-event attention is not possible (MG-023). Review any outstanding work orders against the asset in accordance with SOP-016.
